_comment: run.py chunks sorts every row by its listing title (trailing '#N' item number removed; regexes, case-insensitive). 'review': a random pull, the product is only on the video -> chunkN.txt. 'fixed': the title is the product (matches here and nothing in 'review') -> notes_fixed.tsv, no review. GIVY and $0 rows are giveaways. A title that matches neither list goes to review and chunks names it, so a new seller's naming is one line added here.
